description: In the 8 years our own U.S. Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, has been paid by taxpayer dollars, he has not once, hosted a public in-person Town Hall, nor has he agreed to any debate. He doesn't represent us, only Trump, who has gilded THE PEOPLE'S HOUSE, and his wealthy cronies. So, come to my Town…
